content.text:
The drawing shows a benzene ring with three substituents on adjacent carbons.

- The first ring carbon carries a methyl ester, C(=O)OCH3.
- The second ring carbon, next to it, carries an acetamido group, NHC(=O)CH3.
- The third ring carbon, next to the acetamido carbon, carries a nitro group, NO2.

This is methyl 2-acetamido-3-nitrobenzoate.

SMILES: COC(=O)c1cccc([N+](=O)[O-])c1NC(C)=O
